description: This file defines the FakeTensorProp class, a subclass of torch.fx.Interpreter, which executes an FX graph node-by-node to record metadata using fake tensors. It is used for propagating shape and alias information in a computational graph, specifically for fake tensor propagation in PyTorch's FX framework.

classes.name: FakeTensorProp
classes.description: A class that executes an FX graph node-by-node, recording metadata with fake tensors for shape and alias analysis, used in PyTorch's FX framework.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FakeTensorProp with a module and optional mode, setting up internal state and counters.

methods.name: run_node
methods.description: Processes a single FX graph node, propagating fake tensor metadata, handling special cases for invoke_subgraph nodes, and updating node metadata.

methods.name: propagate
methods.description: Converts input tensors to fake tensors and propagates metadata through the graph.

methods.name: propagate_dont_convert_inputs
methods.description: Runs the propagation within the mode context without converting inputs to fake tensors.
